name: beauty-parlour-fullstack
description: Beauty Parlour Management System - Full Stack Application

scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: npx concurrently "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../beauty-parlour && npm install
